title: A Theory of Price Caps on Non-Renewable Resources
abstract: In December 2022, following Russia's invasion of Ukraine, a G7-led coalition of countries imposed a $60 per barrel price cap on the sales of Russian oil that use western services. This paper provides a theoretical and quantitative analysis of this new tool. We build a tractable equilibrium model in which the financially constrained exporter of a non-renewable resource optimally exerts market power, and the price of the resource varies stochastically. An important insight from this framework is that the supply curve is inelastic and can even be downward sloping, rationalizing the patterns we observe in the data. Contrary to the fears that an introduction of the price cap will cause a damaging oil supply shock, the exporter may have strong incentives to increase extraction following the introduction of a binding price cap. In fact, when the producer is large and has market power, a price cap that applies to all or most sales significantly limits the degree to which market power is used in equilibrium and stabilizes world oil prices. But if the cap is poorly enforced, or if the sanctioned state has access to a noncompliant "shadow" fleet, the cap is less effective at stabilizing world prices.
abstract_zh: 2022年12月，在俄罗斯入侵乌克兰之后，由七国集团（G7）领导的一个国家联盟对使用西方服务销售的俄罗斯石油设定了每桶60美元的价格上限。本文对这一新工具进行了理论和定量分析。我们构建了一个可处理的均衡模型，其中受金融约束的非可再生资源出口国会最优地行使市场势力，且该资源的价格随机变动。该框架的一个重要洞见是，供给曲线缺乏弹性，甚至可能向下倾斜，这为我们在数据中观察到的规律提供了理论依据。与价格上限的引入将引发破坏性石油供给冲击的担忧相反，在具有约束力的价格上限实施之后，出口国可能有强烈的动机增加开采。事实上，当生产者规模较大且具有市场势力时，适用于全部或大部分销售的价格上限，会显著限制均衡中市场势力的运用程度，并稳定世界油价。但是，如果上限执行不力，或者受制裁国家能够利用不合规的“影子”船队，上限稳定世界油价的效果就会减弱。

title: Contracting Structures in Public Procurement: Evidence from Donor-Funded Electrification in Kenya
Climate Policy Reform Options in 2025
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: The year 2025 could be a crucial one for climate policy in the United States. Using an integrated model of energy supply and demand, this paper aims to assess climate policies that the US federal government may consider in 2025 and to evaluate emissions reductions, abatement costs, fiscal impacts, and household energy expenditures across a range of policy scenarios. The model results show several key findings. First, the emissions reductions of the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) are significantly augmented under scenarios that add a modest carbon fee or, to a lesser extent, implement a clean electricity standard in the power sector. Second, net fiscal costs can be substantially reduced in scenarios that include a carbon fee, especially if fossil fuel exports are taxed. Third, expanding the IRA tax credits yields modest additional emissions reductions with higher fiscal costs. Fourth, although none of the policy combinations across these scenarios achieves the US target of a 50%–52% economy-wide emissions reduction by 2030 from 2005 levels, the carbon fee and clean electricity standard scenarios achieve these levels between 2030 and 2035. Finally, rolling back regulations and repealing the Inflation Reduction Act provisions would generate fiscal savings, but these actions would substantially reduce US emissions reductions.
abstract_zh: 2025年可能是美国气候政策的关键一年。本文利用一个综合的能源供需模型，旨在评估美国联邦政府在2025年可能考虑的气候政策，并在一系列政策情景下评估减排量、减排成本、财政影响以及家庭能源支出。模型结果显示出若干关键发现。第一，在情景中加入适度的碳费，或在较小程度上在电力部门实施清洁电力标准，都能显著增强《通胀削减法案》（IRA）的减排效果。第二，在包含碳费的情景中，净财政成本可以大幅降低，尤其是在对化石燃料出口征税的情况下。第三，扩大IRA税收抵免只会带来适度的额外减排，但财政成本更高。第四，尽管这些情景中的政策组合均未能实现美国到2030年相对2005年水平经济整体减排50%–52%的目标，但碳费和清洁电力标准情景在2030年至2035年间达到了这一水平。最后，撤销监管措施并废除《通胀削减法案》的相关条款将带来财政节省，但这些行动将大幅削弱美国的减排成效。

title: Inflation Reduction Act: Origins, Policy Implications, and Research Gaps
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy

title: Who Bears the Burden of Climate Inaction?
abstract: Climate change is already increasing temperatures and raising the frequency of natural disasters in the United States. In this paper, we examine several major vectors through which climate change affects US households, including cost increases associated with home insurance claims and increased cooling, as well as sources of increased mortality. Although we consider only a subset of climate costs over recent decades, we find an aggregate annual cost averaging between $400 and $900 per household; in 10 percent of counties, costs exceed $1,300 per household. Costs vary significantly by geography, with the largest costs occurring in some western regions of the United States, the Gulf Coast, and Florida. Climate costs also typically disproportionately burden lower-income households. Our work suggests the importance of research that looks beyond rising temperatures to extreme weather events; so far, natural disasters account for the bulk of the burden of climate change in the United States. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 气候变化已经在推高美国的气温，并增加自然灾害的发生频率。本文考察了气候变化影响美国家庭的几条主要渠道，包括与房屋保险理赔相关的成本上升、制冷需求增加，以及死亡率上升。尽管我们只考虑了近几十年气候成本的一部分，但我们发现，年度总成本平均在每户400至900美元之间；在10%的县，成本超过每户1300美元。成本的地域差异十分显著，最高的成本出现在美国西部的一些地区、墨西哥湾沿岸和佛罗里达州。气候成本通常也对低收入家庭造成更不成比例的负担。我们的研究表明，研究不应只关注气温上升，还应关注极端天气事件；迄今为止，自然灾害占据了美国气候变化负担的绝大部分。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家的居民可以在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: The Global Effects of Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanisms
abstract: Climate change poses a collective action problem: countries bear the costs of carbon regulation, while benefits are shared globally. Carbon border adjustment mechanisms (CBAMs) aim to realign incentives by extending domestic carbon pricing to imports. Using plant-level data for aluminum and steel, which account for 11% of global CO2 emissions, we document that emissions intensity is income-neutral and uncorrelated with production costs. Carbon pricing introduces a new margin of green comparative advantage. With a quantitative trade model, we show that CBAMs can boost domestic competitiveness, reduce emissions leakage, and facilitate collective climate action, while largely avoiding disproportionate burdens on lower-income countries. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 气候变化带来集体行动问题：各国承担碳监管的成本，而收益则由全球共享。碳边境调节机制（CBAM）旨在通过将国内碳定价延伸至进口产品，重新调整激励。利用铝和钢铁的工厂层面数据——这两个行业占全球CO2排放的11%——我们发现，排放强度与收入水平无关，也与生产成本不相关。碳定价引入了绿色比较优势的新维度。借助一个定量贸易模型，我们表明，碳边境调节机制可以提升国内竞争力，减少排放泄漏，并促进集体气候行动，同时在很大程度上避免对低收入国家造成不成比例的负担。国家经济研究局（NBER）工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家居民可在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: Digital Collateral
Strategic Climate Cooperation and Greenhouse Gas Price Coordination
abstract: Over the past year, policymakers, academics and non-governmental organizations on both sides of the Atlantic have begun talking about how to coordinate policies to reduce methane emissions from the oil and gas sector. While this may seem like an obscure, technical topic, moving forward with this initiative is critical, as the implications for climate cooperation – not just for the US and EU, but for the global community – are profound. In this article, we explore the reasons behind this assertion.
abstract_zh: 在过去一年里，大西洋两岸的政策制定者、学者和非政府组织已经开始讨论如何协调各自的政策，以减少油气行业的甲烷排放。这个议题看似晦涩且技术性很强，但推进这一倡议至关重要，因为它对气候合作的影响——不仅对美国和欧盟，而且对全球社会——都十分深远。在本文中，我们探讨了这一论断背后的原因。

title: Strengthening Enforcement of the Russian Oil Price Cap
Carbon Border Adjustments, Climate Clubs, and Subsidy Races When Climate Policies Vary
abstract: Jurisdictions adopt climate policies that vary in terms of both ambition and policy approach, with some pricing carbon and others subsidizing clean production. We distinguish two types of policy spillovers from these diverse approaches. First, when countries have different levels of climate ambition, free-riders benefit at the expense of more committed countries. Second, when countries pursue different approaches, carbon-intensive producers within cost-imposing jurisdictions are at a relative competitive disadvantage compared with producers in subsidizing jurisdictions. Carbon border adjustments and climate clubs respond to these spillovers, but when countries have divergent approaches, one policy alone cannot address both spillovers. We also consider the policy dynamics arising from carbon border adjustments and climate clubs; both have the potential to encourage upward harmonization of climate policy, but come with risks. Further, the pressures of international competition may result in subsidy races, with attendant risks and benefits.
abstract_zh: 各司法辖区采取的气候政策在力度和政策路径上各不相同，有的对碳进行定价，有的则补贴清洁生产。我们区分了这些多样化路径所产生的两类政策溢出效应。第一，当各国的气候雄心水平不同时，搭便车者会以承担更多责任的国家为代价而获益。第二，当各国采取不同的路径时，在施加成本的辖区内，高碳排放生产者相对于补贴辖区内的生产者处于相对竞争劣势。碳边境调节机制和气候俱乐部可以应对这些溢出效应，但当各国的路径存在分歧时，单一政策无法同时解决两类溢出效应。我们还考察了碳边境调节机制和气候俱乐部所引发的政策动态；两者都有可能促使气候政策向上趋同，但也伴随着风险。此外，国际竞争的压力可能导致补贴竞赛，并带来相应的风险与收益。

title: Design and Implementation of the Price Cap on Russian Oil Exports
abstract: Basic economics teaches that price caps are bad – limiting the price of a good distorts demand and discourages producers from supplying the market. So why did the Biden Administration, led by Janet Yellen, the consummate economist, champion a price cap on oil from Russia after it invaded Ukraine in 2022? The answer is that this price cap, implemented for crude oil in December 2022 and oil products in February 2023, differs significantly from the standard cap discussed in introductory economics classes. This paper explains these differences and describes the first six months this policy has been in existence. We provide background on Russian oil trade and describe the goals, structure, enforcement and economics of the price cap. We review the main concerns and contrast them with the outcomes observed to date.
abstract_zh: 基础经济学告诉我们，价格上限是有害的——限制某种商品的价格会扭曲需求，并打击生产者向市场供应的积极性。那么，为什么在俄罗斯于2022年入侵乌克兰之后，以经济学家身份著称的珍妮特·耶伦（Janet Yellen）所领导的拜登政府却力推对俄罗斯石油实行价格上限？答案在于，这一价格上限于2022年12月针对原油、2023年2月针对石油产品实施，它与入门经济学课程中讨论的标准价格上限有着显著差异。本文阐释了这些差异，并描述了该政策实施的最初六个月。我们介绍了俄罗斯石油贸易的背景，并阐述了价格上限的目标、结构、执行机制及经济学原理。我们梳理了主要的担忧，并将其与迄今观察到的结果进行对比。

title: Economic Implications of the Climate Provisions of the Inflation Reduction Act
abstract: The Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) represents the largest US federal response to climate change to date. We highlight the key climate provisions and assess the act's potential economic impacts. Substantially higher investments in clean energy and electric vehicles imply that fiscal costs may be larger than projected. However, even at the high end, IRA provisions remain cost-effective. The IRA has large impacts on power sector investments and electricity prices, lowering retail electricity rates and resulting in negative prices in some wholesale markets. We find small quantitative macroeconomic effects, including a small decline in headline inflation, but macroeconomic conditions—particularly higher interest rates and materials costs—may have substantial negative effects on clean energy investment. We show that the subsidy approach in the IRA has expansionary supply-side effects relative to a carbon tax but, in a representative-agent dynamic model, is preferable to a carbon tax only in the presence of a strong learning-by-doing externality. We also discuss the economics of the industrial policy aspects of the act as well as the distributional impacts and the possible incidence of the different tax credits in the IRA.
abstract_zh: 《通胀削减法案》（Inflation Reduction Act，IRA）是迄今为止美国联邦政府应对气候变化的最大规模举措。我们重点分析了该法案的主要气候条款，并评估其潜在的经济影响。清洁能源和电动汽车投资的大幅增加意味着财政成本可能高于预期。然而，即便在高端估计下，IRA条款仍具有成本效益。该法案对电力行业投资和电价产生了巨大影响，降低了零售电价，并导致部分批发市场出现负电价。我们发现其宏观经济效应较小，包括总体通胀率略有下降；但宏观经济状况——尤其是较高的利率和材料成本——可能对清洁能源投资产生显著的负面影响。我们表明，与碳税相比，IRA的补贴方式在供给侧具有扩张效应；在一个代表性主体的动态模型中，只有在存在强烈的“干中学”外部性时，该补贴方式才优于碳税。我们还讨论了该法案产业政策方面的经济学，以及其分配效应和各项税收抵免可能的归宿。

title: Money or Power? Choosing Covid-19 Aid in Kenya
Disbursing Emergency Relief through Utilities: Evidence from Ghana
Air Conditioning and Global Inequality
Default Effects and Follow-On Behavior: Evidence from an Electricity Pricing Program
abstract: We study default effects in the context of a residential electricity pricing program. We implement a large-scale randomized controlled trial in which one treatment group is given the option to optin to time-based pricing while another is defaulted into the program but allowed to opt-out. We provide dramatic evidence of a default effect -a significantly higher fraction of households defaulted onto the time-based pricing plan enroll in the program, even though opting out simply involved making a phone call or clicking through to a website.A distinguishing feature of our empirical setting is that we observe follow-on behavior subsequent to the default manipulation. Specifically, we observe customers' electricity consumption in light of the pricing plan they face. This, in conjunction with randomization of the default provision, allows us to separately identify the electricity consumption response of "complacent" households (i.e., those who only enroll in time-based pricing if assigned to the opt-out treatment).We find that the complacent households do reduce electricity use during higher priced peak periods, though significantly less on average compared to customers who actively opt in. However, with complacents comprising approximately 75 percent of the population, we observe significantly larger average demand reductions among consumers assigned to the opt-out group. We examine the extent to which the behavioral responses we observe are consistent with a standard model of switching costs, or with alternative mechanisms including inattention, and preferences constructed based on contextual features of the choice setting.
abstract_zh: 我们在住宅电价计划的背景下研究默认选项效应。我们开展了一项大规模随机对照试验：一组处理组可以选择加入分时电价计划，另一组则被默认纳入该计划，但允许其选择退出。我们提供了显著的默认选项效应的有力证据——被默认纳入分时电价计划的家庭中，参加该计划的比例显著更高，尽管退出只需打一个电话或点击一个网站即可完成。我们实证设定的一个显著特点在于，我们能够观察到默认设置之后的后续行为。具体而言，我们观察了客户在其所面临的电价计划下的用电量。结合默认条款的随机分配，这使我们能够分别识别“自满型”家庭（即仅在被分配到退出组时才会加入分时电价计划的家庭）的用电响应。我们发现，自满型家庭确实会在电价较高的用电高峰时段减少用电，但平均而言，减少幅度明显小于主动选择加入的客户。然而，由于自满型家庭约占总人口的75%，我们观察到被分配到退出组的消费者的平均需求削减幅度明显更大。我们还考察了所观察到的行为反应在多大程度上与转换成本的标准模型相吻合，或与包括注意力不足在内的其他机制以及基于选择情境特征构建的偏好相一致。

title: Low Energy: Estimating Electric Vehicle Electricity Use
abstract: We provide the first at-scale estimate of electric vehicle (EV) home charging. Previous estimates are based on conflicting surveys or are extrapolated from a small, unrepresentative sample of households with dedicated EV meters. We combine billions of hourly electricity meter measurements with address-level EV registration records from California households, including 64,000 EV owners. The average EV increases overall household load by 2.9 kilowatt-hours per day, well under half the amount assumed by state regulators. Results imply that EVs travel less than expected on electric power, raising questions about transportation electrification for climate policy.
abstract_zh: 我们首次给出了电动汽车（EV）家庭充电的大规模估计。以往的估计要么基于相互矛盾的调查，要么是从一小批配备专用电表、缺乏代表性的家庭样本外推得出。我们将数十亿条每小时电表测量数据与加州家庭的地址级电动汽车注册记录相结合，涵盖64,000名电动汽车车主。平均而言，一辆电动汽车使家庭总负荷每天增加2.9千瓦时，远低于州监管机构假设数值的一半。研究结果表明，电动汽车使用电力的行驶里程低于预期，这对以交通电气化推进气候政策的合理性提出了疑问。

title: Does Household Electrification Supercharge Economic Development?
Experimental Evidence on the Economics of Rural Electrification
Heat Exposure and Global Air Conditioning
abstract: Air conditioning adoption is increasing dramatically worldwide as incomes rise and average temperatures go up. Using daily temperature data from 14,500 weather stations, we rank 219 countries and 1,692 cities based on a widely used measure of cooling demand called total cooling degree day exposure. India, China, Indonesia, Nigeria, Pakistan, Brazil, Bangladesh and the Philippines all have more total cooling degree day exposure than the United States—a country that uses 400 terawatt-hours of electricity annually for air conditioning.
abstract_zh: 随着收入增长和平均气温上升，全球空调的普及率正在急剧提高。利用来自14,500个气象站的每日气温数据，我们基于一种被广泛使用的制冷需求指标——总制冷度日暴露量——对219个国家和1,692个城市进行了排序。印度、中国、印度尼西亚、尼日利亚、巴基斯坦、巴西、孟加拉国和菲律宾的总制冷度日暴露量均高于美国——而美国每年用于空调的电量高达400太瓦时。

title: Machine Learning from Schools about Energy Efficiency
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We use high-frequency panel data on electricity consumption to study the effectiveness of energy efficiency upgrades in K–12 schools in California. Using a panel fixed effects approach, we find that these upgrades deliver between 12% and 86% of expected savings, depending on specification and treatment of outliers. Using machine learning to inform our specification choice, we estimate a narrower range: 52%–98%, with a central estimate of 60%. These results imply that upgrades are performing less well than ex ante predictions on average, although we can reject some of the very low realization rates found in prior work.
abstract_zh: 我们利用高频面板电力消费数据，研究加州K–12年级学校节能改造的成效。采用面板固定效应方法，我们发现这些改造所带来的节能量为预期节约量的12%至86%，具体取决于模型设定以及对异常值的处理方式。借助机器学习来辅助确定模型设定，我们将估计范围缩小至52%–98%，中心估计值为60%。这些结果表明，改造的实际效果平均而言低于事前预测，不过我们可以排除先前研究中发现的一些极低的实现率。

title: Hardware, Apps, and Surveys at Scale: Insights from Measuring Grid Reliability in Accra, Ghana
venue: COMPASS '19: Proceedings of the 2nd ACM SIGCAS Conference on Computing and Sustainable Societies

title: Power Quality and Modern Energy for All
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: “Modern energy for all,” an internationally supported initiative to connect populations to electricity services, is expected to help reduce poverty-induced vulnerabilities. It has become a primary strategy for meeting sustainable development goals, especially in sub-Saharan Africa. However, when electricity is supplied by a capacity-constrained grid to a resource-constrained population, the service quality can vary both spatially and temporally. This research explores the quality of electricity services based on a case study of Unguja, Tanzania. Using 1) open-ended interviews, 2) detailed electricity-systems monitoring, and 3) household surveys, we show how voltage quality varies significantly, even within highly localized settings. Fluctuations result in dim lights at best and power outages and broken appliances at worst, denying many Unguja residents the expected benefits of access to modern energy. By combining an extensive understanding of the physical system together with interviews and surveys, this work presents a unique mapping of voltage quality in a system that is financially and physically constrained and highlights the consequences of poor-quality service for poor users.
abstract_zh: “人人享有现代能源”是一项获得国际支持的倡议，旨在让民众接入电力服务，预计将有助于减少贫困导致的脆弱性。它已成为实现可持续发展目标的主要战略，在撒哈拉以南非洲尤为突出。然而，当电力通过产能受限的电网供应给资源匮乏的人口时，服务质量可能在空间和时间上都存在差异。本研究以坦桑尼亚温古贾岛（Unguja）为案例，探讨电力服务的质量。通过1）开放式访谈、2）详细的电力系统监测以及3）家庭调查，我们展示了电压质量即便在高度局部化的环境中也存在显著波动。电压波动最轻会导致灯光昏暗，严重时则造成停电和电器损坏，使温古贾岛的许多居民无法享受获得现代能源所应带来的预期益处。通过将对物理系统的深入理解与访谈和调查相结合，本研究绘制了一幅在财务和物理上均受约束的系统中电压质量的独特图景，并凸显了劣质服务对贫困用户的后果。

title: Solar Microgrids and Remote Energy Access: How Weak Incentives Can Undermine Smart Technology
venue: Economics of Energy and Environmental Policy

title: Do Energy Efficiency Investments Deliver? Evidence from the Weatherization Assistance Program
abstract: A growing number of policies and programs aim to increase investment in energy efficiency, because conventional wisdom suggests that people fail to take-up these investments even though they have positive private returns and generate environmental benefits. Many explanations for this energy efficiency gap have been put forward but there has been surprisingly little field testing of whether the conventional wisdom is correct. This paper reports on the results of an experimental evaluation of the nation’s largest residential energy efficiency program – the Weatherization Assistance Program – conducted on a sample of approximately 30,000 households in Michigan. The findings suggest that the upfront investment costs are about twice the actual energy savings. Further, the model-projected savings are more than three times the actual savings. While this might be attributed to the “rebound” effect – when demand for energy end uses increases as a result of greater efficiency – the paper fails to find evidence of significantly higher indoor temperatures at weatherized homes. Even when accounting for the broader societal benefits derived from emissions reductions, the costs still substantially outweigh the benefits; the average rate of return is approximately -7.8% annually.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的政策和计划旨在增加节能投资，因为通行观点认为，尽管此类投资具有正的私人收益并能带来环境效益，人们却未能采纳。关于这种“能源效率缺口”，已经提出了许多解释，但令人惊讶的是，对于通行观点是否正确，实地检验却很少。本文报告了对全美规模最大的住宅节能计划——住房节能改造援助计划（Weatherization Assistance Program）——进行的实验评估结果，样本为密歇根州约30,000户家庭。研究结果表明，前期投资成本约为实际节能量的两倍。此外，模型预测的节能量是实际节能量的三倍多。虽然这可能归因于“反弹效应”——即能源效率提高后，能源终端用途的需求随之增加——但本文并未发现改造后住房室内温度显著升高的证据。即便考虑到减排所带来的更广泛的社会效益，成本仍大大超过收益；平均年收益率约为-7.8%。

title: Appliance Ownership and Aspirations among Electric Grid and Home Solar Households in Rural Kenya
venue: American Economic Review Papers and Proceedings
abstract: In Sub-Saharan Africa, there are active debates about whether increases in energy access should be driven by investments in electric grid infrastructure or small-scale “home solar” systems (e.g., solar lanterns and solar home systems). We summarize the results of a household electrical appliance survey and describe how households in rural Kenya differ in terms of appliance ownership and aspirations. Our data suggest that home solar is not a substitute for grid power. Furthermore, the environmental advantages of home solar are likely to be relatively small in countries like Kenya, where grid power is primarily derived from non-fossil fuel sources.
abstract_zh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲，关于能源获取的增加应依靠电网基础设施投资还是依靠小型“家用太阳能”系统（例如太阳能灯和家用太阳能系统）存在激烈争论。我们总结了一项家庭电器调查的结果，并描述了肯尼亚农村家庭在电器拥有情况和意愿方面的差异。我们的数据表明，家用太阳能无法替代电网供电。此外，在肯尼亚这类电网电力主要来自非化石燃料的国家，家用太阳能的环境优势可能相对较小。

title: Running Randomized Field Experiments for Energy Efficiency Programs: A Practitioner's Guide

title: The Demand for Energy-Using Assets among the World's Rising Middle Classes
The Frontiers of Energy
Under the Grid? Barriers to Electrification in Rural Kenya
Are the Non-Monetary Costs of Energy Efficiency Investments Large? Understanding Low Take-up of a Free Energy Efficiency Program
venue: American Economic Review Papers and Proceedings
abstract: We document very low take-up of an energy efficiency program that is widely believed to be privately beneficial. Program participants receive a substantial home “weatherization” retrofit; all installation and equipment costs are covered by the program. Less than 1 percent of presumptively eligible households take up the program in the control group. This rate increased only modestly after we took extraordinary efforts to inform households—via multiple channels–about the sizable benefits and zero monetary costs. These findings are consistent with high non-monetary costs associated with program participation and/or energy efficiency investments.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了一项被普遍认为对私人有利的节能计划的极低参与率。参与者可以获得一次大规模的家庭“节能改造”，所有安装和设备成本均由该计划承担。在对照组中，不到1%的推定合格家庭参与了该计划。即便我们付出了特别的努力，通过多种渠道向家庭告知其巨大收益以及零货币成本，参与率也只是略有提高。这些发现与参与该计划和/或节能投资所伴随的高非货币成本相一致。

title: Cursed Resources? Political Conditions and Oil Market Outcomes
abstract: We analyze how a country’s political institutions affect oil production within its borders. We find a pronounced negative relationship between political openness and volatility in oil production, with democratic regimes exhibiting less volatility than more autocratic regimes. This relationship holds across a number of robustness checks including using different measures of political conditions, instrumenting for political conditions and using several measures of production volatility. Political openness also affects other oil market outcomes, including total production as a share of reserves. Our findings have implications both for interpreting the role of institutions in explaining differences in macroeconomic development and for understanding world oil markets.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了一个国家的政治制度如何影响其境内的石油生产。我们发现，政治开放程度与石油产量波动性之间存在显著的负相关关系：民主政权的产量波动性低于更为专制的政权。这一关系在多项稳健性检验中均成立，包括使用不同的政治条件衡量指标、对政治条件进行工具变量估计以及使用多种产量波动性衡量指标。政治开放程度还影响其他石油市场结果，包括产量占储量的比例。我们的研究结论既有助于理解制度在解释宏观经济发展差异中的作用，也有助于理解世界石油市场。

title: An Economic Perspective on the EPA's Clean Power Plan
Powering up China: Income Distributions and Residential Electricity Consumption
venue: American Economic Review Papers and Proceedings
abstract: Current forecasts suggest that the vast majority of growth in energy demand will come from the developing world, and that China will play a major part in that growth. This paper presents evidence suggesting that the shape of the income distribution, which is typically omitted from forecasting models, plays a major role in driving household acquisition of energy-using durable goods in rural China. We use province-level data for rural households to show that the share of the population living above the poverty line is an important determinant of household appliance holdings even controlling for average household income.
abstract_zh: 目前的预测表明，能源需求的绝大部分增长将来自发展中国家，而中国将在这一增长中扮演主要角色。本文提供的证据表明，收入分布的形态——通常被预测模型所忽略——在驱动中国农村家庭购置耗能耐用品方面发挥着重要作用。我们利用省级农村家庭数据表明，即便控制了家庭平均收入，生活在贫困线以上的人口比例仍是家庭电器持有量的重要决定因素。

title: 'Opt-Out' Rates at Motherhood across High-Education Career Paths: Selection versus Work Environment
abstract: This paper assesses whether work environment has a causal efiect on mothers’ labor force participation. Using data from the 2003 National Survey of College Graduates and a sample of Harvard alumnae, we flnd large variation in mothers’ labor force attachment across high-education flelds. We use the rich information available in each dataset, and the longitudinal nature of the Harvard data, to try to disentangle whether these patterns re∞ect selection across graduate degrees, or variation in the di‐culty of combining work with family. We conclude that a non-family-friendly work environment can \push women out of the labor force at motherhood.
abstract_zh: 本文评估工作环境是否对母亲的劳动参与具有因果效应。利用2003年全国大学毕业生调查的数据以及哈佛大学女校友样本，我们发现，在不同的高等教育专业领域中，母亲的劳动力依附程度存在显著差异。我们利用每个数据集中丰富的信息，以及哈佛数据的纵向特征，试图厘清这些模式反映的是研究生学位之间的选择效应，还是兼顾工作与家庭的难度差异。我们的结论是，不利于家庭的工作环境会在母亲身份出现时将女性推出劳动力市场。

title: Deregulation, Consolidation and Efficiency: Evidence from U.S. Nuclear Power
Dynamic Pricing of Electricity
venue: American Economic Review Papers and Proceedings
abstract: As both a regulator and an academic, Fred Kahn argued that end-use electricity consumers should face prices that reflect the time-varying marginal costs of generating electricity. This has been very slow to happen in the US, even in light of recent technological advances that have lowered costs and improved functionality for meters and automated demand response technologies. We describe these recent developments and discuss the remaining barriers to the proliferation of time-varying electricity pricing.
abstract_zh: 弗雷德·卡恩（Fred Kahn）既是监管者又是学者，他主张终端电力消费者应面对反映发电时变边际成本的价格。在美国，这一转变进展非常缓慢，即便技术进步已降低了电表和自动需求响应技术的成本并提升了其功能。我们描述了这些最新进展，并讨论了分时电价普及所面临的剩余障碍。

title: Enforcement of Vintage Differentiated Regulations: The Case of New Source Review
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: How Will Energy Demand Develop in the Developing World?
abstract: Over the next 25 to 30 years, nearly all of the growth in energy demand, fossil fuel use, associated local pollution, and greenhouse gas emissions is forecast to come from the developing world. This paper argues that the world's poor and near-poor will play a major role in driving medium-run growth in energy consumption. As the world economy expands and poor households' incomes rise, they are likely to get connected to the electricity grid, gain access to good roads, and purchase energy-using assets like appliances and vehicles for the first time. We argue that the current forecasts for energy demand in the developing world may be understated because they do not accurately capture growth in demand along the extensive margin, as low-income households buy their first durable appliances and vehicles. Within a country, the adoption of energy-using assets typically follows an S-shaped pattern: among the very poor, we see little increase in the number of households owning refrigerators, vehicles, air conditioners, and other assets as incomes go up; above a first threshold income level, we see rapid increases of ownership with income; and above a second threshold, increases in ownership level off. A large share of the world's population has yet to go through the first transition, suggesting there is likely to be a large increase in the demand for energy in the coming years.
abstract_zh: 未来25至30年，预计能源需求、化石燃料使用、相关的当地污染以及温室气体排放的几乎全部增长都将来自发展中国家。本文认为，世界上的贫困人口和近贫人口将在驱动中期能源消费增长方面发挥重要作用。随着世界经济扩张和贫困家庭收入提高，他们很可能会接入电网、获得良好的道路，并首次购置耗能资产，如家用电器和车辆。我们认为，目前对发展中国家能源需求的预测可能被低估了，因为这些预测未能准确捕捉到沿扩展边际（extensive margin）增长的需求，即低收入家庭首次购买耐用家电和车辆。在一国之内，耗能资产的普及通常呈S形曲线：在极度贫困人口中，随着收入上升，拥有冰箱、车辆、空调及其他资产的家庭数量几乎没有增加；超过第一个门槛收入水平后，拥有率随收入迅速上升；超过第二个门槛后，拥有率增长趋于平缓。世界上很大一部分人口尚未经历第一次转变，这表明未来几年能源需求很可能大幅增长。

title: Sacred Cars? Cost-Effective Regulation of Stationary and Non-stationary Pollution Sources
The Design and Implementation of U.S. Climate Policy
abstract: Economic research on climate change has been crucial in advancing our understanding of the consequences associated with global warming as well as the costs and benefits of policies that might reduce emissions. As nations work to develop climate policies, economic insights into their design and implementation are ever more important. This volume looks at the possible effects of various climate policies on economic outcomes. The studies examine topics that include coordination - or lack thereof - between the federal and state governments and the specific consequences of various climate policies for the agricultural, automotive, and buildings sectors.
abstract_zh: 经济学对气候变化的研究，在深化我们对全球变暖后果以及减排政策成本与收益的认识方面至关重要。各国在制定气候政策时，经济学对其设计与实施的洞见变得愈加重要。本卷考察了各类气候政策对经济结果可能产生的影响。研究内容包括联邦政府与州政府之间的协调（或缺乏协调），以及各类气候政策对农业、汽车和建筑部门的具体影响。

title: The Guy at the Controls: Labor Quality and Power Plant Efficiency
venue: In R. Freeman and K. Shaw, eds., International Differences in the Business Practices and the Productivity of Firms, University of Chicago Press
abstract: This paper examines the impact of individual human operators on the fuel efficiency of power plants. Although electricity generation is a fuel and capital intensive enterprise, anecdotal evidence, interviews, and empirical analysis support the hypothesis that labor, particularly power plant operators, can have a non-trivial impact on the operating efficiency of the plant. We present evidence to demonstrate these effects and survey the policies and practices of electricity producing firms that either reduce or exacerbate fuel efficiency differences across individual plant operators.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了个体操作人员对发电厂燃料效率的影响。尽管发电是一项高度依赖燃料和资本的事业，但轶事证据、访谈和实证分析均支持这样一种假设：劳动力，尤其是电厂操作员，可以对电厂的运行效率产生不容忽视的影响。我们提供证据以证明这些效应，并考察了发电企业的政策与实践，这些政策与实践会缩小或扩大不同电厂操作员之间的燃料效率差异。

title: Electricity Markets
venue: In S. N. Durlauf and L. E. Blume, eds., The New Palgrave Dictionary of Economics, Second Edition

title: Inefficiencies and Market Power in Financial Arbitrage: A Study of California's Electricity Markets
abstract: For two years prior to the collapse of California's restructured electricity market, power traded in both a forward and a spot market for delivery at the same times and locations. Nonetheless, prices in the two markets often differed in significant and predictable ways. This apparent inefficiency persisted, we argue, because most firms believed that trading on inter‐market price differences would yield regulatory penalties. For the few firms that did make such trades, it was not profit‐maximizing to eliminate the price differences entirely. Skyrocketing prices in 2000 changed the major buyers' (utilities') incentives and exacerbated the price differentials between the markets.
abstract_zh: 在加州重组后的电力市场崩溃之前的两年里，同一时间、同一地点交付的电力同时在远期市场和现货市场进行交易。然而，两个市场的价格经常以显著且可预测的方式存在差异。我们认为，这种明显的低效率之所以持续存在，是因为大多数企业认为，利用市场间价格差异进行交易会招致监管处罚。对于少数确实进行此类交易的企业而言，彻底消除价格差异并不符合利润最大化。2000年价格飙升改变了主要买方（即公用事业公司）的激励，并加剧了两个市场之间的价格差异。

title: Local Solutions to Global Problems: Climate Change Policy and Regulatory Jurisdiction
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy

title: Do Markets Reduce Costs? Assessing the Impact of Regulatory Restructuring on US Electric Generation Efficiency
abstract: While neoclassical models assume static cost-minimization by firms, agency models suggest that firms may not minimize costs in less-competitive or regulated environments. We test this using a transition from cost-of-service regulation to market-oriented environments for many US electric generating plants. Our estimates of input demand suggest that publicly owned plants, whose owners were largely insulated from these reforms, experienced the smallest efficiency gains, while investor-owned plants in states that restructured their wholesale electricity markets improved the most. The results suggest modest medium-term efficiency benefits from replacing regulated monopoly with a market-based industry structure. (JEL D24, L11, L51, L94, L98)
abstract_zh: 尽管新古典模型假设企业进行静态成本最小化，但代理模型表明，在竞争较弱或受监管的环境中，企业可能并不会将成本最小化。我们利用美国众多发电厂从成本加成监管向市场导向环境转型的过程对此进行了检验。我们对要素需求的估计表明，公有电厂的所有者在很大程度上不受这些改革的影响，其效率提升最小；而在批发电力市场完成重组的州，投资者所有电厂的效率提升最大。研究结果表明，以市场为基础的产业结构取代受监管的垄断，能够带来适度的中期效率收益。（JEL D24, L11, L51, L94, L98）

title: Coordinating on Lower Prices: Pharmaceutical Pricing under Political Pressure
The Efficiency of Electricity Generation in the U.S. After Restructuring
venue: In J. Griffin and S. Puller, eds., Electricity Deregulation: Choices and Challenges, University of Chicago Press
abstract: Over the past eleven years, US electric utilities have faced significant changes to their competitive and regulatory environments. The Energy Policy Act of 1992 opened access to transmission for nonutility generating plants. Then, beginning with California in 1996, nearly half the states passed and a smaller number enacted restructuring legislation that involved complete retail access. The industry restructuring is designed to enhance economic efficiency at all levels of operation, including distribution, transmission, generation and retail services. The gains are likely to be largest in electric generation because generation costs are the largest component of end-use costs and restructuring has a larger impact on generation than on other segments of the electricity industry, such as transmission and distribution, which are likely to remain at least partially regulated. This chapter will evaluate changes in the efficiency of electric generation from restructuring. It both summarizes the current state of knowledge on the topic and serves as a roadmap for future work.
abstract_zh: 在过去十一年里，美国电力公用事业公司面临着竞争和监管环境的重大变化。《1992年能源政策法》（Energy Policy Act of 1992）向非公用事业发电厂开放了输电网络的使用权。随后，从1996年加州率先开始，近半数州通过了相关立法，少数州则颁布了涉及全面零售准入的重组法规。行业重组旨在提升运营各个环节的经济效率，包括配电、输电、发电和零售服务。收益很可能在发电环节最为显著，因为发电成本是终端使用成本中最大的组成部分，而重组对发电环节的影响大于对输电和配电等其他环节的影响，后两者很可能至少部分地继续受到监管。本章将评估重组对发电效率的变化。本章既总结了该主题的现有研究进展，也为未来的研究提供了路线图。

Why Do Manufacturers Issue Coupons? An Empirical Analysis of Breakfast Cereals
Has the "Million-Dollar Cap" Affected CEO Pay?

title: Electricity Markets: Should the Rest of the World Adopt the United Kingdom's Reforms?
Measuring Duopoly Power in the British Electricity Spot Market
abstract: This article presents an empirical study of market power in the British electricity industry. Estimates of price-cost markups are derived using direct measures of marginal cost and several approaches that do not rely on cost data. Since two suppliers facing inelastic demand dominate the industry, most oligopoly models predict prices substantially above marginal costs. All estimates indicate that prices, while higher than marginal costs, are not nearly as high as most theoretical models predict. Regulatory constraints, the threat of entry, and financial contracts between the suppliers and their customers are considered as possible explanations for the observed price levels. (JEL L13, L94)
abstract_zh: 本文对英国电力行业的市场势力进行了实证研究。我们利用对边际成本的直接度量以及若干不依赖成本数据的方法，推导出价格—成本加成率的估计值。由于两家面临缺乏弹性需求的供应商主导着该行业，大多数寡头模型预测价格将大幅高于边际成本。所有估计结果均表明，价格虽高于边际成本，但远不及大多数理论模型所预测的水平。我们还考虑了监管约束、进入威胁以及供应商与客户之间的金融合约，作为对所观察到的价格水平的可能解释。（JEL L13, L94）

title: Increases in Executive Pay Following Privatization
venue: Journal of Economics and Management Strategy

title: Strategic Bidding in a Multiunit Auction: An Empirical Analysis of Bids to Supply Electricity in England and Wales
abstract: I consider bidding behavior in the daily electricity auction in England and Wales. Theoretical work on uniform-price multiunit procurement auctions suggests that bidders offering more than one unit have an incentive to increase their bids at high quantities. If a bid sets a high equilibrium price, it applies to all inframarginal units. I find evidence of strategic bid increases in the electricity auctions. First, plants that are likely to be used after other plants are already operating bid more. Second, the larger supplier submits higher bids for similar plants. Last, bids for a given plant are slightly higher on days when more of the capacity that is typically inframarginal to that plant is available.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了英格兰和威尔士日前电力拍卖中的投标行为。关于统一价格多单位采购拍卖的理论研究表明，提供多个单位报价的投标人有动机在高数量处提高其报价。如果某一报价设定了较高的均衡价格，那么该价格将适用于所有边际内单位。我发现了电力拍卖中存在战略性提高报价的证据。第一，在其他电厂已经运行之后才可能被调用的电厂，报价更高。第二，规模较大的供应商对相似电厂提交的报价更高。最后，当某一电厂通常处于其边际内的产能可用性更高时，该电厂的报价在当日会略高。

title: Decomposing the Sources of Incumbency Advantage in the U.S. House
Political Constraints on Executive Compensation: Evidence From the Electric Utility Industry

title: Voltage Quality and Economic Activity

title: Do Households Smooth Small Consumption Shocks? Evidence from Anticipated and Unanticipated Variation in Home Energy Costs
abstract: Home energy costs comprise a significant fraction of household budgets, particularly for poor families. This paper analyzes how household consumption responds to changes in home energy outlays over the course of the year. We specify Euler equations describing nondurable and food consumption and then rely on changes in energy prices and weather severity to identify exogenous changes in disposable income. We distinguish changes in energy spending that are anticipated, for instance because it is winter in the Northeast, from those that are unanticipated, for instance because it is an unusually cold winter. We find little evidence of excess sensitivity to anticipated variation among households in the Consumer Expenditure Survey 1990-2002, even among those without substantial financial assets. However, the latter group experiences large consumption reactions to unanticipated changes.
abstract_zh: 家庭能源支出在家庭预算中占据相当大的比重，对贫困家庭而言尤为如此。本文分析了家庭消费如何随全年家庭能源支出的变化而做出反应。我们设定描述非耐用品和食品消费的欧拉方程，然后利用能源价格和天气严寒程度的变化来识别外生的可支配收入变动。我们区分了可预期的能源支出变化（例如，因为东北部正值冬季）与不可预期的能源支出变化（例如，因为今年冬天异常寒冷）。在1990至2002年的消费者支出调查中，我们几乎没有发现家庭对可预期波动存在过度敏感性的证据，即使是在那些没有大量金融资产的家庭中也是如此。然而，后一类家庭对不可预期的变化表现出较大的消费反应。

title: Ownership Change, Incentives and Plant Efficiency: The Divestiture of US Electric Generation Plants
The Distribution of Power: Decentralization and Favoritism in Energy Infrastructure
